faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question4: What is the PaperClue Mind Map, and how does it function?
faq.answer4: The Mind Map empowers scholars to focus on niche topics, facilitating the extraction of core ideas from research papers without the necessity of reading through entire articles. By utilizing advanced AI, PaperClue automatically synthesizes key concepts from papers, enabling users to swiftly grasp essential takeaways. Furthermore, the Mindmap visually organizes these insights, providing a clear representation of how various ideas and research findings are interconnected. This not only enhances the efficiency of the research process and saves time but also deepens the understanding of complex academic topics.
faq.question5: How does PaperClue's Mind Map differ from Google Scholar and other platforms commonly used by scholars and researchers?
faq.answer5: PaperClue's Mind Map offers a distinctive approach compared to Google Scholar and other academic platforms by offering a more focused, keyword-driven approach to research. Unlike Google Scholar, which retrieves a broad range of papers, PaperClue's Mindmap allows users to narrow down their research to specific keywords, making it easier to focus on niche topics. This focused approach helps researchers efficiently identify the most relevant papers, rather than sifting through extensive lists.
faq.question6: Is it possible to save my searches on the Mind Map and receive regular updates on emerging trends?
faq.answer6: Absolutely! The Mind Map lets you save searches and receive regular updates on emerging trends and publications, keeping you informed about the latest developments in your field.
faq.question1: What is the Research Refiner, and how does it operate to support academic writing?
faq.answer1: The Research Refiner, a core feature of PaperClue, is designed to help researchers and scholars elevate the quality of their academic writing. It delivers detailed feedback and intelligent suggestions to improve clarity, coherence, and adherence to academic standards, ensuring manuscripts meet the expectations of scholarly publishing.
faq.question2: How does PaperClue's Research Refiner differ from traditional manual proofreading?
faq.answer2: PaperClue's Research Refiner significantly reduces turnaround time from the typical couple of weeks required for manual proofreading to just a few minutes—while maintaining high precision and consistency. It offers a cost-effective solution without compromising on quality, making it ideal for researchers seeking speed, accuracy, and affordability.
faq.question3: What are the advantages of replacing traditional proofreading with AI-powered proofreading?
faq.answer3: AI-powered proofreading brings a transformative edge to modern academic and professional work. It matches the precision of traditional proofreading while delivering faster, more consistent feedback. In a world where time matters, AI streamlines editing without sacrificing quality. With real-time, adaptive suggestions on grammar, tone, and clarity, AI ensures focus on ideas—not mechanics. It's the smart way to meet high standards in less time, aligning your workflow with today's fast-paced demands.
faq.answer7: Yes, we take data security seriously. Your research data is encrypted and we never share it with third parties. Kindly refer to our Privacy Policy and Information Protection Policy at the bottom of this page.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: What is the Premium Team Plan, and how does it benefit research groups?
faq.answer1: The Premium Team Plan on PaperClue is a subscription option designed specifically for professors, students, and research groups. It allows one central account holder (typically a professor) to add and manage student or lab member accounts under a single, cost-effective premium subscription. This makes it easy to provide all team members with access to premium features—like the Mind Map tool, Research Refiner, and more—at a discounted per-user rate, ideal for enhancing productivity and collaboration across research teams.
faq.answer2: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. If you upgrade, you'll be charged the prorated difference. If you downgrade, you'll receive a prorated credit to your account.
faq.answer3: Yes, we offer special pricing for students, educators, and academic institutions. Contact our support team with proof of academic status to receive your discount code.
faq.question4: Is there a limit to document uploads?
faq.answer4: Free accounts can upload up to 5 pages per document and 1 document per week. Pro accounts have unlimited uploads with a 100-page limit per document. Team accounts have unlimited uploads with a 500-page limit per document.
faq.question5: How accurate is the plagiarism detection?
faq.answer5: Our plagiarism detection compares your document against millions of academic papers, websites, and publications with over 98% accuracy. It identifies both exact matches and similar content.

introduction.welcome: PaperClue.ai (“the Company”) is an AI assistant designed to support research and academic writing.
introduction.company: Our company, PaperClue Inc., is a software service provider headquartered in Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. As a Japanese corporation, we strictly comply with the Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI) and are committed to appropriately safeguarding the personal information of our customers.
introduction.interest: We appreciate your interest in our website. Protecting your data is one of our highest priorities.
introduction.outline: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your information when you use our AI-powered research assistant platform. By accessing or using PaperClue.ai, you are deemed to have agreed to the practices described in this policy.

basicPolicy.title: 1. Basic Policy on Personal Information Protection
basicPolicy.content: PaperClue.ai collects and uses personal information only to the extent necessary to achieve the purposes described below. We will not use personal information in ways that encourage or facilitate illegal or unethical activities.

definition.title: 2. Definition of Personal Information
definition.intro: “Personal Information” refers to any data that can be used to identify an individual, including but not limited to:

items.item1: Name, address, date of birth, gender, occupation, telephone number, email address, etc.
items.item2: Information that, although not identifying on its own, can be easily combined with other data to identify an individual.

definition.compliance: All such information is handled in full compliance with applicable data protection laws.

management.title: 3. Management of Personal Information
management.content: We take all reasonable measures to ensure the security of your personal information and data. These include maintaining secure systems, establishing robust management structures, implementing security applications, and providing comprehensive training to our employees. Such measures are designed to prevent unauthorized access, loss, damage, alteration, or leakage, and to manage personal data in a strict and effective manner.

collection.title: 4. Collection and Use of Personal Information
collection.content: We collect personal information by lawful and fair means and use it only within the scope necessary for our business operations.

disclosure.title: 5. Disclosure of Information to Third Parties
disclosure.intro: We do not disclose personal information to third parties except in the following cases:

items.item1: When explicit consent has been obtained from the individual concerned.
items.item2: When disclosure is required by law.
items.item3: When personal information is provided to a third party entrusted with handling the information.
items.item4: When information is shared with designated recipients within the intended scope of use.
items.item5: When necessary to protect human life, physical safety, or property and it is difficult to obtain the individual’s consent.
items.item6: When necessary to improve public health or promote the sound growth of children and obtaining consent is difficult.
items.item7: When cooperation with national or local authorities is required to fulfill legal obligations.

appropriateManagement.title: 6. Security Measures for Personal Information
appropriateManagement.content: We take reasonable preventive measures and implement security management practices to protect personal information from unauthorized access, leakage, or other security risks.

compliance.title: 7. Compliance with Laws and Regulations
compliance.content: We comply with all applicable Japanese laws and regulations regarding personal information in our possession, and we regularly review and improve the content of this policy.

transfer.title: 8. Provision to and Joint Use with Third Parties
transfer.content: Except as permitted by law, we will not provide personal information to third parties without the customer’s consent.

safetyMeasures.title: 9. Measures to Ensure the Accuracy and Security of Personal Information
safetyMeasures.content: We implement thorough security measures to maintain the accuracy and safety of personal information.

procedures.title: 10. Procedures for Disclosing, Correcting, etc. Personal Data
procedures.content: If you wish to request disclosure or correction of personal data held by us, please contact us via the email address below. Requests by mail, fax, or telephone will not be accepted. Please note that we may require identity verification through designated procedures and documents before processing your request.

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility for Refund

The purchased service (based on Prime, Premium, Pro or Team Plan) was not delivered or inaccessible due to a verified system issue on our end.
You canceled a subscription renewal within the grace period but were still charged.
Our support team fails to resolve a verified technical issue within 14 business days after your report.

nonRefundable.title: 3. Non-Refundable Situations
nonRefundable.intro: Refunds will not be granted in the following cases:
conditions: Dissatisfaction with subjective outcomes (e.g., tone, ranking, or quality of AI feedback).
The purchased service has been accessed, downloaded, or used successfully.
Incorrect or incomplete information was provided by the user.
The refund request is submitted more than 7 days after purchase.
Subscription periods that have already started and been used (partially or fully) are not eligible for prorated refunds.

conditions: Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled before the next billing date.

Refunds for renewals will only be issued if the cancellation request is made within 3 days of renewal and you have not used the service during that period.
